operating_notes.text: Natural gas marketing segment result fell to ₹3,077.58 Cr in FY26 from ₹7,446.28 Cr in FY25.
Petrochemicals segment posted a loss of ₹1,408.22 Cr in FY26 against ₹37.31 Cr in FY25.
Standalone borrowings rose to ₹17,414.29 Cr at 31 March 2026 from ₹13,576.76 Cr a year earlier.
During FY26, GAIL added approximately 2,000 km of pipeline network and achieved LPG transmission of 4.6 MMTPA.
FY26 gas transmission 122.18 MMSCMD; gas sales 104.21 MMSCMD; LPG transmission highest ever at 4,600 TMT.
Petrochemical plant utilisation 94% in FY26; polymers sold ~1,085 KTA (785 GAIL, 300 BCPL).
CBG sales ~88,174 MT in FY26; 6 CBG plants under construction with 95 TPD capacity.
Petronet LNG declared Force Majeure on 3rd March 2026 reducing RLNG allocation to zero; 190 MMSCM RLNG supplied in H1FY27 as mitigation.
As of October 2026, 3,119 km of the 3,345 km JHBDPL project has been commissioned.
Gurdaspur-Jammu Pipeline (GJPL) project delayed to Dec 2026; 78 km of 160 km commissioned.
Kochi-Koottanad-Bengaluru-Mangaluru Pipeline (KKBMPL) completion delayed to March 2027; 715 km commissioned and 947 km completed of 951 km revised execution length.
Board approved slump sale transfer of Varanasi, Patna, Ranchi, East Singhbhum, Cuttack, and Khordha CGD areas to GAIL Gas Ltd effective Jan 1, 2027.
Board accorded in-principle approval on 30 October 2026 for IPO listing of GAIL Gas Limited diluting up to 25% stake.
H1FY27 natural gas transmission volume reached 120 MMSCMD and gas marketing stood at 96 MMSCMD.

timeline.summary: Q4FY26 results (consolidated): revenue ₹35,705.49 Cr, net profit ₹1,481.46 Cr.
GAIL reported FY26 consolidated revenue of ₹1,42,094 Cr and PAT of ₹7,582 Cr, with a final dividend recommendation of ₹0.50 per share.
2026-05-22: GAIL investor presentation guides FY27 capex at ₹11,600 Cr (FY26: ₹9,594 Cr) and flags the Hormuz closure as an LNG supply risk.
Q2FY27 results (consolidated): revenue ₹47,301.03 Cr (+32.7% YoY), net profit to shareholders ₹4,719.66 Cr (includes ₹271.68 Cr from discontinued operations; continuing operations ₹4,452.07 Cr).
GAIL revised the completion schedule for the Durgapur-Haldia and Dhamra-Haldia pipeline sections to March 2027 due to land access issues.
GAIL extended the completion schedule for the Gurdaspur-Jammu Pipeline to December 2026 due to forest permission delays in Punjab.
GAIL extended the completion schedule for the Kochi-Koottanad-Bengaluru-Mangaluru Pipeline (KKBMPL) project to March 2027 with no additional investment required.
GAIL Board approved slump sale of six CGD areas to wholly owned subsidiary GAIL Gas Ltd effective 1 January 2027.
GAIL Board approved in-principle the listing of wholly owned subsidiary GAIL Gas Limited via IPO with up to 25% dilution.
GAIL reported H1FY27 capex of ₹7,600 Cr
GAIL reported H1 FY27 standalone revenue of ₹84,905 crore and PAT of ₹8,943 crore.
Link to audio/video recording of GAIL (India) Limited Q2 FY 2026-27 earnings conference call released on 30.10.2026.
